proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9237.1 biḍāla gives Nepali birālo, Bengali birāl/bilāl/bilāi, Oriya bilāi and western Pahari bəraḷe in the addendum. Selected biralo/berale/biɽal and bilei/bilui/bileⁱ/bileya fit the rhotic and reduced bilāi branches; source vowel differences and final glide are retained. Local Indo-Aryan transmission is unresolved. Exact response: bileⁱ.
